title: thalictrum minus subsp. saxatile
intro: Thalictrum minus subsp. saxatile, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Rue include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic agent, making it useful for treating conditions such as arthritis, muscle spasms, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of Meadow Rue include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
